The Forbidden Caverns of Archaia: Background

Referee's Note: The introductory background below should not be immediately available to player characters. Players should only advance their understanding of the larger context through dungeon exploration, discovery, and role-play.

Long ago, an ancient people, the Archaians, built a thriving civilization in the shadow of a great mountain. Among their accomplishments, they studied the dark mysteries of arcane energy. Through knowledge of the cosmos, the Archaians learned to harness their innate magical abilities and bend the rules of spell-casting to their will. Over time, the Archaians became reclusive, selfish, and lost themselves within the eldritch energies they studied. The three greatest Archaian sorcerers, called The Archons of the Trium, grew in power and challenged their god, Anu-Eya.

From his celestial ziggurat, the great Anu-Eya cast down the Archons and punished his people with lightning from above and great earthquakes from below. The quakes swallowed the city into the ground and created a labyrinth of canyons and sunken ruins. Finally, the Hell-Fire Furnace exploded in fire and brimstone, turning the once fertile region into a barren, desolate wasteland.

Despite the cataclysm, the Archons survived. Reconstituting themselves over the centuries, they struck a bargain with Impurax, the God of Corruption, Rot, and Decay. In return for aid in their revenge against Anu-Eya, the Archons agreed to help Impurax's priesthood build an army of monstrous humanoids—The Horde of the Rotting Hand—and use the ancient power of the Archaian Hengegates to gate an aspect of Impurax onto the Material Plane.

Coinage and Conversions

The exploration and plundering of Archaia has brought a new coinage into Middenmark: Archinium Pieces (ap). In Eastdale, only Retep's Relics or The Golden Crown can exchange these coins (for a 5% fee).

Adventure Hooks

  • Antiquities Bounty: The owner of Retep's Relics in Eastdale hires adventurers to explore the ruins of ancient Archaia and return with rare antiquities.
  • Caravan Raid: A caravan was waylaid by large orcs near The Forbidden Zone. The Red Temple is organizing a party to investigate.
  • Arcane Lore: Muirron the Magician pays good coin for books, scrolls, and etchings from Archaia. Locals say the Inglorious Bastards recently walked away from his mansion with platinum pieces.
  • The Darkwood Gauntlet: A caravan guarded by Hudson's Grey Company was destroyed by an owlbear on "The Gauntlet" road to Westkeep. Radloc Hudson offers 50 gp to all comers who join the hunt.
  • Strength in Numbers: At The Saucy Tart, rival adventuring bands discuss teaming up to tackle the outer perimeter of Archaia.
  • Barrow Mound in the Darkwood: Ranger Herrick Broadside from Westkeep found a huge barrow mound and standing stones in the Darkwood Forest before being driven off by trolls.
  • The Jeweled Chalice: Rival party The Heathens returned from Archaia with a gem-encrusted chalice worth 5,000 gp in Threshold and claim to have a map back to the site.
